text: By forgiving, you become part of cosmic mercy. To hold a grudge means to try to stop within yourself the flow of divine energy. That is why feeling resentment is so unpleasant. Forgiveness is a conscious decision to reopen the locks and allow the flow of universal Love and Mercy to wash both you and the one who offended you. You do not justify the act, but you free both souls from the prison of the past.
